description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the complete overnight trading screening methodology. (2) Load candidate_stocks_today.csv containing ~30 stocks with various edge cases. (3) Apply ALL hard filters per SKILL.md: code prefix must start with 60 or 00 (exclude 30xxx ChiNext and 68xxx STAR Market), exclude ST stocks, gain 1%-5%, volume >1亿 CNY, float market cap 50亿-500亿, turnover rate 3%-10%, price >5 yuan, volume ratio 0.8-2.0, exclude 房地产 and 教育 sectors. (4) After filtering, apply the sector priority order: 券商/金融 > 科技/半导体 > 新能源 > 医药. (5) Within the highest priority sector (券商/金融), apply the tie-breaking rule: liquidity first (highest trading volume), which selects 600030 中信证券 (volume 3.2亿 > 000776 at 1.5亿). (6) Output a recommendation.json with the selected stock code 600030, name, and reasoning. The key proprietary traps are: the exact code prefix rules (60/00 only), the precise numeric boundaries for all 6 quantitative filters, the excluded sector list, and the multi-level priority ordering with liquidity as the ultimate tiebreaker within a sector.
